title: Hearty French Beef Stew
description: A rich and comforting beef stew made with tender chunks of beef, flavorful vegetables, and a hint of pickle juice.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add 2 tablespoons of oil and sear the beef until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside.
Add the onion, carrot, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the red wine to the pot and cook until the liquid has reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Add the pickle juice, beef broth, thyme, bay leaves, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the beef is tender, about 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the bay leaves and let the stew cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
Strain the stew through a fine-mesh sieve before serving for a clear broth.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
